description:
Genes with a known function for a trait in Arabidopsis and their pulse and legume orthologues: TAIR mutant phenotypes,
curator summaries and GO biological-process terms (experimental evidence marked) matching the trait words, ranked
by evidence (the trait written as a phrase, mutant lines, summary, experimental GO, publications), each with its orthologues in pea (3 genomes), faba bean, narrow-leafed lupin, common bean, pigeonpea, cowpea, mungbean, adzuki bean, soybean, wild soybean, peanut, Medicago and red clover
from Ensembl Compara (type one2one/one2many/many2many and identity). trait: words ('flowering time',
'seed size', 'nodule'; use Arabidopsis wording, e.g. 'silique dehiscence' for pod shatter); species: one Ensembl genome to keep (e.g. 'pisum_sativum', 'glycine_max', 'vicia_faba').
Function in the crop is inferred from Arabidopsis: say so and give the orthology type.
name: arabidopsis_trait_genes
